$comment: Explicit input-encoding registry. Contract f1-extensions/1, step-1 exit seal (m3). Names match case-insensitively against the XML declaration encoding value; an absent declaration means UTF-8.

utf-8.note: XML default when no declaration is present.

ascii.note: ASCII bytes decode identically under strict UTF-8.

iso-8859-1.note: Actual byte to U+0000..U+00FF mapping; bytes 0x80-0x9F land on U+0080..U+009F, never on C1 control remaps.

rules: Any other declared name refuses with unsupported-encoding before tokenization.
Bytes that are malformed for the selected codec refuse with invalid-encoding.
Raw bytes are hashed before decoding; emitted bytes always follow the native writer (UTF-8 preamble).

Named references decode with the pinned native semantics only: the five predefined lowercase names, their five uppercase variants, and decimal/hex numeric references. Anything else is xml-entity-reference-unsupported.
